specs.Operating System: Android 4.4 or above, iOS 9.0 or above
specs.Metrics Measured: Heart Rate, Blood Oxygen, Blood Pressure, Body Temperature
specs.Compatible Phone Models: All current iPhone models, all current Android models (Android 4.4+)

features: 24/7 Health Indicator Monitoring: Fitness tracker supports real-time monitoring of heart rate, blood oxygen, blood pressure, and body temp. You can view these real-time health indicators on your wrist at any time, and view all-day data records in the application to understand your health status around the clock; accurately track sleep status (deep/shallow/awake stage) and analyze your sleep quality, help make adjustments to get better rest, and lead a healthy lifestyle

25 Sports Modes & All-Day Activity Tracking: Fitness tracker watch provides 25 sports modes, such as running, cycling, yoga, and rugby; no matter how you exercise, the fitness tracker will adapt to your needs, tracking and recording all-day activities, including steps, distance and calories burned, to help you achieve your fitness goals more effectively; you can use the GPS connected to your phone to track outdoor activities and get accurate distance, speed and route information in the app

Smart Message Notification: Fitness watch can receive incoming calls, text messages, and social software message notifications from mobile phones, including Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, WhatsApp, Messenger, etc.; through the vibration reminder of the watch, you can also receive caller information and reject calls, helping you not to miss important calls or messages when exercising or muting your phone; drinking reminders and sedentary reminders will help you develop good living habits

Intimate Life Companion: A new menstrual cycle reminder function has been added for women's health to help female users manage their physiological health scientifically; in addition, the fitness watches for women and men also has various smart functions, including: alarm clock, stopwatch, do not disturb mode, flip wrist screen, remote photo control, family health, making it an intimate life assistant

1.1" AMOLED HD Color Touchscreen: Activity and fitness trackers features a stunning 1.1" AMOLED display (126x294) with vibrant colors, paired with a ABS frosted curved frame and skin-friendly TPU straps for a stylish look; there are multiple dial styles to choose from in the APP, or use your favorite photos in the album to match your style, personalize your device according to your preferences, mood or clothing; watch dial display module is intuitive and clear, easy to read

Excellent Performance: Activity tracker uses magnetic fast charging to reduce the consumption of battery life. After fully charged, it can be used for up to 7-10 days in regular use and up to 30 days in standby; this smart fitness watch is IP67 waterproof and can be safely used for washing straps, washing hands and exercising in the rain; fitness tracker is compatible with iOS 9.0+ and Android 4.4+; the adjustable wristband ensures comfortable wearing
